name: mac
pronunciation_note: Owner request 2026-11-04: 'Hey Mac' as an optional trigger, separate from MacBook/Mac Studio/Mac Mini (which keep plain 'Mac' as a look-alike so they do not fire on it). Addressed-only: bare 'Mac' is an everyday word. 'Mack'/'Max' are the sound-alikes; 'Mack' is an accepted spelling because it is the same sound. German 'Mag' sounds identical (/maːk/), so it is an accepted spelling too; 'Max' only adds an s and stays a near-miss. English 'mag' (/mæɡ/) differs from 'Mac' and is dropped from the list only because accept_stems are language-agnostic.
